mapper.select:
select a.ORGNAME as ImpLssuedUnitName ,t.REALNAME as ImpLssuedStaffidName,r.* from TBL_RISK_IMPLEMENT r left join TBL_ORGANIZATION a on r.IMP_LSSUED_UNIT=a.ORGID left join TBL_STAFF t on r.IMP_LSSUED_STAFFID=t.STAFFID where 1=1 and toreport=1
and IMP_RISK_NAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.impRiskName} ),'%')
and id in
#{item}
order by id desc

select r.*,s.REALNAME as staffidname,o.ORGNAME as staffdeptname,u.ORGNAME as staffunitname from TBL_RISK_REVIEW r left join tbl_staff s on s.STAFFID=r.STAFFID left join tbl_organization o on o.orgid=r.STAFFDEPT left join tbl_organization u on u.orgid=r.STAFFUNIT where reviewid=#{id}
